item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 19/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong today. It will remain relatively cool in the morning over the region. With the monsoon moderating, it will be warm during the day over Guangdong tomorrow and over the weekend. A relatively humid easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China early next week. It will be cloudier over the region.
